item.title: Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce Paid ‘Over $160,000’ for NYC Wedding Permit, Mayor Zohran Mamdani Says
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest trending news. Today, we're talking about Taylor Swift's recent wedding to Travis Kelce at the iconic Madison Square Garden in New York City.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: So, what do we know about the big day? Well, for starters, the couple had to pay a pretty penny to host their event in the heart of Manhattan. According to NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani, Taylor Swift has already paid over $160,000 for the permit, which included street closures and traffic management around the arena.
[Short sound clip of NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani's statement]
Host: That permit covered the rehearsal dinner on July 2 and the wedding itself on July 3. As for the wedding details, we know that Taylor and Travis wore Christian Dior Haute Couture outfits, and they didn't have traditional bridesmaids or groomsmen. Instead, Taylor's brother Austin was her man of honor, and Jason Kelce was Travis' best man. And, in a fun twist, actor and comedian Adam Sandler officiated the ceremony.
[Upbeat music transitions in]
Host: But here's the really exciting part: the wedding featured some amazing performances. Stevie Nicks took the stage, and Paul McCartney even performed The Beatles' classic hit "I Want to Hold Your Hand" for the first time since 1963. Can you imagine being a guest at that wedding?
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
